question: Does Felt-chan truly find Reinhard annoying? Even though she’s depicted as having discarded her femininity, being told “I’m your ally, and yours alone” by the strongest handsome guy on the planet would have an effect on any girl, I think.
answer: She really does find him annoying. Felt’s ideal type is Old Man Rom. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say she’s only into older men. The author is saying some pretty outrageous stuff here.
